description: Frozen inputs of test case NI-002 (end-to-end run and result archive, thermal design 3.3, 6.3, chapter 7 and 9.4). One 24 h run of the example Sat01 scene with the Power stand-in, Orbit two-body 400 km orbit, Orbit sun_position_ephemeris builtin and sun_intensity with eclipse, and the earth_flux provider. The scenario contains 15 complete eclipses and the entry of a 16th one, a load stop and start pair, one injected Power result with event_required True (a confirmed supply shortfall in a known window), one physical battery constraint event (a supply shortfall of the stand-in battery under a request ramp in eclipse), refused and accepted restart commands, and, in a separate repeated run, one injected Power result with valid False. Every value is an illustrative test value; no device has been selected or measured.

provenance.power_model: sdtwin_sim.power_stand_in, a stand-in written from the Power design report (P1 to P11, valid and event_required of its 5.1 and 5.5, apply_power_event of 5.6); it is not the production Power module
provenance.schedule_note: Absolute times were fixed once from the eclipse phases of this orbit (exits of eclipses 0, 3, 4 and 9 at 3858.33 s, 20521.81 s, 26076.30 s and 53848.77 s) and end in .5 s so that no scheduled instant falls on the 60 s output grid. The test checks the intended illumination of every scheduled instant against its own cylindrical shadow calculation.
provenance.temperature_note: The 55 degree Sun tilt and the 60 W request keep the battery temperature inside the stand-in material range [253.15, 333.15] K during the disconnected periods; the injected window lies in eclipse 0 while the satellite is still warm, the stop and start pair follows the exit of eclipse 3, and the physical shortfall is placed in the last 950 s of eclipse 9 so that the dark rest after it is short.

orbit.attitude_comment: Sun-tracking attitude: body +Z is the orbit normal projected normal to the satellite-to-Sun direction u, body +X = cos(tilt) u - sin(tilt) w with w = Z x u, body +Y = Z x X. The SolarArray01 front (body +X) sees the Sun at the tilt angle.

power.initial_x_n_source: Sat01 scene; x_p computed from the same cell-pack lithium inventory as the explicitly declared scene initial value.
power.record_initial_T_B_K_note: Validation copy of the ThermalState initial temperature; runtime temperature is read from the thermal trial state.
power.base_request_source: rated_power_W of the Compute01 asset sdtwin.example.compute_board 0.1.0

ramp.comment: Request rises for 900 s and returns to base at end_s, about 50 s before eclipse exit.

event_required.reason: supply_shortfall: injected by the NI-002 test through PowerCoupling.solve
event_required.comment: while the load is connected inside the window the wrapped solve returns valid True, event_required True, can_supply_request False without ports; while it is disconnected inside the window the stand-in result is returned with can_supply_request False; outside the window the stand-in result is returned unchanged

invalid.reason: numerical_failure: injected by the NI-002 test through PowerCoupling.solve
invalid.comment: the first Power trial at or after from_s returns valid False without ports; the run must report it and stop

hot_probe.comment: short coupled run of the same scene and orbit with J above its declared range [253.15, 358.15] K and B above [263.15, 318.15] K but inside the Power material range; Thermal must only report the ranges
